title: Tenable, Inc. security advisory (AV26-820)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-820 Date: August 17, 2026 As of August 14, 2026, Tenable, Inc. is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: Security Center Prior to 6.9.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available.
